body: Before cli/v0.1.2, push ran gh secret set NAME --body - with the value on stdin. gh has no dash-means-stdin rule: a non-empty --body is the literal value, so every pushed secret was stored as the single character dash. The fix drops --body; with --body absent and stdin not a terminal, gh reads stdin and trims only trailing CR/LF. A test runs the real runner against a fake gh on PATH and pins the argv and exact stdin bytes for values with dollar, space-hash, quotes, a lone dash, a flag-like value and trailing newlines; it fails with the old flag. Fixed and released 2026-10-14; users who pushed with 0.1.0 or 0.1.1 were told to re-push.
title: v0.1.2 fix: github push sends no --body flag at all (issue #1)
